run.change_description:
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956

improve FAQ text for zsh completions

summary.intent: Let users source ripgrep's zsh completion function directly (`source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`) instead of only writing it to a file on `fpath`, fixing the `_arguments: ... can only be called from completion function` error this previously raised, and document the new option in the FAQ alongside the existing `fpath` method.
summary.issue_fit: Met — sourcing the generated completion no longer errors and still registers `_rg` for tab completion, matching issue BurntSushi/ripgrep#2956 and the change description's two-step test plan.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff reviewed (both changed files: FAQ.md, crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh). Reproduced the pre-fix error and the fix by sourcing the file's base and head content in a scratch, offline zsh after `compinit`; no CI or caller-supplied check evidence was provided for this range.

findings.title: Fix the dropped-subject sentence in the zsh source caveat
findings.trigger: Reading the new FAQ.md caveat sentence about the source-based zsh completion method as merged (FAQ.md:138-139).
findings.impact: The clause after the first comma drops its subject ("while this approach is easier to setup, is generally slower..."), so the sentence reads as ungrammatical, which can momentarily obscure the tradeoff the FAQ is trying to convey to readers choosing between the two zsh setup methods.
findings.change: Restore the subject and use the verb form "set up", e.g. "while this approach is easier to set up, it is generally slower than the previous method, and it will add more time to loading your shell prompt."

observations.fact: The diff also fixes an unrelated pre-existing typo in the bash/fish intro sentence ("generate completes" -> "generate completions") while touching the same paragraph.

requirements.source: spec/pr-2957-packet/pr-body/"Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1."
requirements.evidence: Sourcing crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh as it exists at base 79cbe89 (after `compinit`) reproduces `_arguments:comparguments:325: can only be called from completion function`; sourcing the same file at head 855bfa6 exits 0 with no error.

After sourcing rg.zsh at head 855bfa6 (with `compinit` already run), `compdef _rg rg` executes and `$_comps[rg]` is set to `_rg`, which is the mechanism that makes subsequent tab completion for `rg` resolve to the sourced function.

check_evidence.check: zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -i -d <scratch dump>; source <crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh at 855bfa6>; echo EXIT=$?; print \${_comps[rg]}"
